states.state: Unobserved trial: exactly one ball is drawn uniformly from a bag. Counts: gray=5, cyan=7, white=9, pink=6. All possible colors are listed; the draw has NOT happened.

outcome.instructions: Predict the unobserved random draw. Return the conditional probability of each candidate event given the bag. These events are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.

focus.instructions: Will the unobserved draw produce a white ball? Use the conditional probability given only this bag.

group.instructions: Predict which mutually exclusive group the unobserved sampled color belongs to. Probabilities are determined by the bag counts.
criteria: The drawn color is one of: gray, pink
The drawn color is one of: cyan
The drawn color is one of: white

action.instructions: Choose a legal move maximizing win/draw/loss under perfect play by both sides. Earlier wins are not preferred; all equally best moves count.
